This is the Tomb. Defensive measures[XENO:n ]
prevent intruders from entering.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You will have to circumvent these[XENO:n ]
to move within the Tomb.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

One thing before we enter.[XENO:n ]
Alvis, you can see the future, like me?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I am from a long line of seers dedicated[XENO:n ]
to serving the imperial family.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]My visions help to protect the empire.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
But you're a Homs...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes. But that is for another time.[XENO:n ]
My ancestry is not easily explained.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]

And my ability to see the future[XENO:n ]
is equally complicated.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
You might say I have my own ritual.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]Is it not the same for you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

No. My visions appear suddenly,[XENO:n ]
without warning.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

At first, they're obscure. Then as it gets closer[XENO:n ]
to the event, I start to understand.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It seems you possess[XENO:n ]
a power greater than I.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I still have not seen any danger[XENO:n ]
befall Her Highness.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Not much use as a seer then, are you?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Nothing passes you by, does it?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Now you see why I asked for your help. What a lucky[XENO:n ]
coincidence that I happened to see you in danger.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]A coincidence?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But I've seen you use the Monado![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Monado has been passed down[XENO:n ]
the imperial line for generations.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The sword of the Giant God. It is compelled[XENO:n ]
to do its master's bidding.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Magnified greatly, it has the power to control[XENO:n ]
the very fabric of our world - ether.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Control the ether and your will is made reality.[XENO:n ]
I willed it, and it happened. That is all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Perhaps due to that power, the High Entia[XENO:n ]
sealed away the Monado for centuries.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Eventually, it found its way into the hands of[XENO:n ]
the Homs, and then you, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

A coincidence or something more?[XENO:n ]
You must discover this yourself.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
For you are the one who wields the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
The Giant God is stirring.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
